name: Humblewood Ancestries (2024)
_note: 2024 Humblewood ancestries follow 2024 rules: ability score increases come from BACKGROUNDS, not ancestry, so there is no abilityScores field. Two-lineage ancestries model their lineages as subraces. Traits granting a CHOICE of skill are described in text (pick manually); traits granting a fixed skill use the skills array. Base-AC traits (Hedge) and natural-weapon traits (Talons/Antlers/Bite) are described in text — add natural weapons via the Attacks section. Some flavor is paraphrased; verify against the book.

races.name: Corvum
races.description: Crow-like birdfolk with dark feathers and sharp minds (Size: Medium). Often cast as schemers, they trade in knowledge and work subtly behind the scenes.

traits.name: Glide
traits.description: When falling, use your Reaction to descend gently at 60 ft per round and take no fall damage; if you fall at least 10 ft this way you may fly up to your Speed horizontally (never upward). Not while using a shield or heavy weapon, in Heavy armor, or encumbered.

traits.name: Talons
traits.description: Your Unarmed Strike with your talons deals 1d4 Piercing damage, and you have Advantage on Strength (Athletics) checks to climb surfaces your talons can grip.

traits.name: Learned
traits.description: You gain proficiency in one of the following skills of your choice: Arcana, History, Nature, or Religion.

traits.name: Appraising Eye
traits.description: When you take the Study action to examine an object, you learn its magical properties, how it might be used or activated, and a fair market price. You must finish a Short or Long Rest before using this again.

traits.name: Language of the Air
traits.description: You understand Auran, though you cannot speak it naturally.

subraces.name: Dusk Corvum
subraces.description: At home in society, quick to read social cues and seize an advantage.

traits.name: Skulker
traits.description: You have Advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made in Dim Light or Darkness.

traits.name: Street Smarts
traits.description: You gain proficiency in the Insight skill.

subraces.name: Kindled Corvum
subraces.description: Certain they're the smartest in the room, and persuasive enough to prove it.

traits.name: Convincing
traits.description: You gain proficiency in either the Deception or Persuasion skill (your choice), and you have Advantage on Charisma checks to convince someone of your knowledge on a topic related to your Learned skill.

traits.name: Sharp Mind
traits.description: You learn one additional language, gain proficiency with a Tool of your choice, and can perfectly recall anything you've seen or heard within the past month.

races.name: Gallus
races.description: Communal, wildfowl-like birdfolk who prize social bonds, honest work, and hospitality (Size: Medium). The birdfolk most likely to live among the humblefolk.

traits.name: Glide
traits.description: When falling, use your Reaction to descend gently at 60 ft per round and take no fall damage; if you fall at least 10 ft you may fly up to your Speed horizontally (never upward). Not while using a shield/heavy weapon, in Heavy armor, or encumbered.

traits.name: Wing Flap
traits.description: As a Bonus Action, propel yourself upward a distance equal to half your Speed. You can combine it with a normal jump, but not while gliding.

traits.name: Communal
traits.description: When you make an Intelligence (History) check about the history of your race, culture, or community, you're proficient in History and add double your Proficiency Bonus.

traits.name: Militia Training
traits.description: You have proficiency with simple weapons.

traits.name: Of the People
traits.description: You gain proficiency with one Artisan's Tool of your choice: Brewer's Supplies, Carpenter's Tools, or Smith's Tools.

traits.name: Language of the Air
traits.description: You understand Auran, though you cannot speak it naturally.

subraces.name: Bright Gallus
subraces.description: A natural leader who lifts up those around them.

traits.name: Inspiring
traits.description: As an Action, inspire an ally who can see and hear you; they can roll a d4 and add it to one ability check, attack roll, or saving throw. Once per Short or Long Rest.

traits.name: Understanding
traits.description: You have proficiency in the Insight skill.

subraces.name: Huden Gallus
subraces.description: Deeply connected to the land and the Great Rhythm of nature.

traits.name: One With the Land
traits.description: You have proficiency in the Nature skill.

traits.name: Seedspeech
traits.description: Your connection to the Great Rhythm lets you commune with nearby plant life to learn simple information about the surrounding area.

races.name: Luma
races.description: Small dove- or pigeon-like birdfolk with an eccentric, mystical view of the world (Size: Small) — shunned by some, celebrated by others.

traits.name: Glide
traits.description: When falling, use your Reaction to descend gently at 60 ft per round and take no fall damage; if you fall at least 10 ft you may fly up to your Speed horizontally (never upward). Not while using a shield/heavy weapon, in Heavy armor, or encumbered.

traits.name: Wing Flap
traits.description: As a Bonus Action, propel yourself upward a distance equal to half your Speed. Combine with a normal jump, but not while gliding.

traits.name: Touched
traits.description: You know one cantrip of your choice from the sorcerer spell list. Charisma is your spellcasting ability for it.

traits.name: Fated
traits.description: You can choose to reroll any D20 Test; you must use the new roll. You can't use this again until you finish a Long Rest.

traits.name: Language of the Air
traits.description: You understand Auran, though you cannot speak it naturally.

subraces.name: Sable Luma
subraces.description: Overlooked on the fringes of society, but destined for greatness.

traits.name: Hard to Read
traits.description: Creatures have Disadvantage on Wisdom (Insight) checks made against you, and you have Advantage on Charisma (Deception) checks against non-lumas.

traits.name: Resilience
traits.description: You have Advantage on saving throws against being Charmed.

subraces.name: Sera Luma
subraces.description: Celebrated for an almost unnatural beauty and grace.

traits.name: Songbird
traits.description: You can cast charm person once per Long Rest, requiring no somatic components. Charisma is your spellcasting ability for it.

races.name: Raptor
races.description: Hawk- and eagle-like birdfolk — swift, sharp-eyed hunters and trackers who favor the wilds over society (Size: Small or Medium, your choice).

traits.name: Size & Speed
traits.description: Choose Small or Medium. Your walking Speed is 25 ft if Small or 30 ft if Medium — set your Speed to match.

traits.name: Glide
traits.description: When falling, use your Reaction to descend gently at 60 ft per round and take no fall damage; if you fall at least 10 ft you may fly up to your Speed horizontally (never upward). Not while using a shield/heavy weapon, in Heavy armor, or encumbered.

traits.name: Talons
traits.description: Your Unarmed Strike with your talons deals 1d4 Piercing damage, and you have Advantage on Strength (Athletics) checks to climb surfaces your talons can grip.

traits.name: Keen Senses
traits.description: You have proficiency in the Perception skill.

traits.name: Woodland Hunter
traits.description: Your accuracy lets you treat Three-Quarters Cover as Half Cover, and Half Cover as no cover, against targets you attack.

traits.name: Language of the Air
traits.description: You understand Auran, though you cannot speak it naturally.

subraces.name: Maran Raptor
subraces.description: At home near water as well as in the trees; patient and watchful.

traits.name: Swimmer
traits.description: You have a Swim Speed of 25 feet.

traits.name: Patient
traits.description: You gain a benefit when you take the Ready action, reflecting a hunter's patience (see book for specifics).

subraces.name: Mistral Raptor
subraces.description: Swift wind-riders built for speed and pursuit.

traits.name: Diving Strike
traits.description: You excel at striking from above, capitalizing on a glide or dive to close on prey (see book for specifics).

races.name: Strig
races.description: Owl-like birdfolk — the most imposing of the birdfolk, prizing strength and endurance (Size: Medium). Excellent hunters at home in the wild.

traits.name: Glide
traits.description: When falling, use your Reaction to descend gently at 60 ft per round and take no fall damage; if you fall at least 10 ft you may fly up to your Speed horizontally (never upward). Not while using a shield/heavy weapon, in Heavy armor, or encumbered.

traits.name: Talons
traits.description: Your Unarmed Strike with your talons deals 1d4 Piercing damage, and you have Advantage on Strength (Athletics) checks to climb surfaces your talons can grip.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.description: You have Darkvision with a range of 60 feet.

traits.name: Patterned Feathers
traits.description: You have Advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks when you attempt to Hide in a forest.

traits.name: Language of the Air
traits.description: You understand Auran, though you cannot speak it naturally.

subraces.name: Stout Strig
subraces.description: Hearty and strong, able to endure and overpower.

traits.name: Imposing
traits.description: You have proficiency in the Intimidation skill.

traits.name: Brawler
traits.description: When you hit a target with your Talons, you can choose to Grapple that target as a Bonus Action.

subraces.name: Swift Strig
subraces.description: A tireless ranger who covers ground without missing a step.

traits.name: Swift
traits.description: Your base walking Speed increases to 35 feet.

traits.name: Survivor
traits.description: You have proficiency in the Survival skill.

races.name: Cervan
races.description: Deer-like humblefolk — grounded, practical, and community-minded (Size: Medium).

traits.name: Practical
traits.description: You gain proficiency in one of the following skills of your choice: Athletics, Medicine, Nature, or Survival.

traits.name: Surge of Vigor
traits.description: Your tenacity lets you shrug off devastating blows: when an attack deals more than half your current remaining hit points in damage (even if it would drop you to 0), you can respond with a surge of resilience (see book). Once per Long Rest.

subraces.name: Grove Cervan
subraces.description: Nimble, fleet-footed deerfolk.

traits.name: Swift
traits.description: Your base walking Speed increases to 35 feet.

traits.name: Standing Leap
traits.description: Your long jump is up to 30 feet and your high jump up to 15 feet, with or without a running start.

traits.name: Nimble Step
traits.description: Opportunity Attacks made against you are rolled with Disadvantage.

subraces.name: Pronghorn Cervan
subraces.description: Larger, stronger deerfolk built for the charge.

traits.name: Robust Build
traits.description: Your carrying capacity and the weight you can push, drag, or lift are doubled.

traits.name: Antlers
traits.description: You can gore with your antlers: your Unarmed Strike with them deals 1d6 + your Strength modifier Piercing damage.

races.name: Hedge
races.description: Hedgehog-like humblefolk — small, gentle, and quilled (Size: Small). Base walking Speed 25 ft and Burrow Speed 15 ft.

traits.name: Burrow
traits.description: You have a Burrow Speed of 15 feet.

traits.name: Spiny Quills
traits.description: Your quills prevent you from wearing armor, but provide exceptional protection: your base Armor Class is 14 + your Dexterity modifier. (Set your AC accordingly.)

traits.name: Curl Up
traits.description: As an Action, curl into a ball of quills: while curled you can't move, attack, or cast spells with somatic components, and your base AC becomes 19.

traits.name: Forest Magic
traits.description: You know the druidcraft cantrip, and you can cast animal messenger as a 2nd-level spell once, regaining that use after a Short or Long Rest. Charisma is your spellcasting ability for these.

traits.name: Speak with Bugs
traits.description: Through sounds and gestures you can communicate simple ideas with insects and similar tiny creatures.

subraces.name: Arma Hedge
subraces.description: Armadillo- and pangolin-like hedges with bony armor plates instead of spiny quills, blessed by Henwin with a deep connection to the earth. (Humblewood 2 Playtest.)

traits.name: Armor Plates
traits.description: You have tough plates of bone or keratin covering your body, making it impossible to wear armor (though you can still use shields). Your base AC is 17 and does not benefit from your Dexterity modifier.

traits.name: Earthblessed
traits.description: You know the resistance cantrip and can cast it without requiring material components. Additionally, you can cast cymatic sight without material components once, regaining the ability to do so when you finish a long rest. Charisma is your spellcasting ability for these spells.

traits.name: Plate Wall
traits.description: As an action, you can focus on defense, presenting your foes with a solid wall of armor plates. Until the start of your next turn, you have resistance to all damage except psychic, and you have advantage on ability checks and saving throws to resist being moved or knocked prone. When you take this action your speed becomes 0 until the start of your next turn. If you are moved before your next turn, your Plate Wall effect ends and you land prone in the space you were moved to.

traits.name: Speech of Stone and Soil
traits.description: You have the magical ability to speak with rocks, crystals, and minerals. When doing so, you impart limited sentience on the stone for a number of minutes equal to your proficiency bonus; during this time the rock communicates with you telepathically and can transmit any basic occurrences it has experienced (pressure, temperature, wetness, or sounds such as words spoken near it).

traits.name: Size
traits.description: Arma hedges stand between around 3 and 4½ feet tall. Your size is Small or Medium.

races.name: Jerbeen
races.description: Tiny, brave jerboa-like humblefolk with big hearts (Size: Small, standing 2–3 feet).

traits.name: Nimbleness
traits.description: You can move through the space of any creature that is a size larger than yours, but can't stop there.

traits.name: Take Heart
traits.description: You have Advantage on Strength saving throws and on saving throws against being Frightened (see book for the exact condition).

traits.name: Team Tactics
traits.description: You can take the Help action as a Bonus Action.

traits.name: Standing Leap
traits.description: Your long jump is up to 30 feet and your high jump up to 15 feet, with or without a running start.

subraces.name: Rockburrow Jerbeen
subraces.description: Chinchilla- and pika-like jerbeens — taller and sturdier than their fieldscurry cousins, adapted to some of the toughest environments in Everden. (Humblewood 2 Playtest.)

traits.name: Cheek Pouches
traits.description: Your cheeks have elastic pouches that stretch to fit ⅓ cubic feet and let you safely store up to 2 lbs of objects. While stored this way, objects are concealed and have total cover. You can stow or retrieve objects in your cheek pouches as a bonus action.

traits.name: Fluff Up
traits.description: As a bonus action, you can give yourself advantage on Intimidation checks against creatures that are Medium or Large.

traits.name: Thick Fur
traits.description: You have resistance to nonmagical bludgeoning damage.

traits.name: Size
traits.description: Rockburrow jerbeens stand between 2½ and 3½ feet tall. Your size is Small.

races.name: Mapach
races.description: Raccoon-like humblefolk — resourceful tinkers and scroungers (Size: Medium). Base walking Speed 30 ft and Climb Speed 20 ft.

traits.name: Climber
traits.description: You have a Climb Speed of 20 feet.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.description: You have Darkvision with a range of 60 feet.

traits.name: Resilience
traits.description: You have Advantage on saving throws against being Poisoned, and Resistance to Poison damage.

traits.name: Scroungecraft
traits.description: You are proficient with Tinker's Tools and can fashion useful items from scrap and salvage.

traits.name: Skulker
traits.description: You have Advantage on Stealth checks made in Dim Light and Darkness.

races.name: Vulpin
races.description: Fox-like humblefolk — clever, charming, and quick-witted (Size: Medium).

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.description: You have Darkvision with a range of 60 feet.

traits.name: Bite
traits.description: Your fangs let you make a natural bite: an Unarmed Strike that deals 1d6 Piercing damage (you may use Strength or Dexterity for the attack).

traits.name: Evasive
traits.description: You add your Intelligence modifier as a bonus on all Dexterity saving throws.

traits.name: Bewitching Guile
traits.description: You can cast charm person as a 1st-level spell and ambush prey as a 2nd-level spell, each once, regaining the use on a Long Rest. Intelligence is your spellcasting ability for these.

races.name: Greno
races.description: Amphibious folk inspired by frogs and toads. They live comfortably in water and on land thanks to their webbed hands and feet, which make them excellent swimmers. (Humblewood Playtest.)

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.description: You can breathe air and water.

traits.name: Bombastic Croak
traits.description: As a bonus action, when you make a weapon attack or a spell attack that has a verbal component, you can empower your attack with a war croak. If the attack hits, it is a critical hit. Your croak can be heard 1,000 feet away. Once you use this ability you can't use it again until you finish a long rest.

traits.name: Jumper
traits.description: Your long jump is a distance equal to your walking speed, and your high jump is a distance equal to half your walking speed, with or without a running start.

traits.name: Swimmer
traits.description: You have a swimming speed equal to your walking speed.

traits.name: Size
traits.description: Grenos tend toward either streamlined or round builds. Your size is Medium or Small (your choice).

subraces.name: Venim
subraces.description: Inspired by poisonous frogs, these flamboyant grenos warn of their dangerous skin with vibrant colors.

traits.name: Poison Skin (3/Day)
traits.description: When a creature touches you or hits you with a melee weapon attack, you can use your reaction to force that creature to make a Constitution saving throw (DC 8 + your Constitution modifier + your proficiency bonus). On a failed save, the creature takes poison damage equal to double your proficiency bonus and is poisoned until the end of your next turn.

traits.name: Warning Colors
traits.description: You are proficient in the Intimidation skill.

subraces.name: Veret
subraces.description: Inspired by wood frogs, grass frogs, and green frogs, these adaptable grenos are particularly sensitive to their environments.

traits.name: Sticky Feet
traits.description: You have a climbing speed equal to your walking speed.

traits.name: Sensitive Skin
traits.description: You can cast the detect poison and disease spell at will, without verbal or material components. When you reach 5th level, you can also cast the protection from poison spell once per long rest without expending a spell slot. Wisdom is your spellcasting ability for these spells.

subraces.name: Verru
subraces.description: Inspired by toads, these tough grenos are well-adapted to life on land and have a reputation for great endurance.

traits.name: Unslowed Toad
traits.description: You have advantage on saving throws to resist gaining levels of exhaustion and being petrified.

traits.name: Warty Skin
traits.description: You have resistance to slashing damage.

abilityChoice.hint: typical: venim CON & WIS, veret WIS & DEX, verru WIS & STR

races.name: Sylph
races.languages: Birdfolk, plus one language of your choice; you also understand Auran but can't speak it
races.description: The smallest of all birdfolk, inspired by hummingbirds — swift, lively, and full of energy, capable of great feats of endurance and bravery. (Humblewood 2 Playtest.)

traits.name: Determined
traits.description: You have advantage on saving throws against being frightened and against taking levels of exhaustion.

traits.name: Diminutive
traits.description: You can move through the space of any creature that is of a size larger than yours.

traits.name: Healing Stillness
traits.description: When you take a short rest, you can choose to enter a deep slumber lasting at least 1 hour to preserve your energy. During this slumber you are unconscious, and any Hit Dice you spend while resting this way are rolled with advantage. If you wake early you don't gain this benefit, but you can still spend Hit Dice as normal and gain the normal benefits of a short rest.

traits.name: Hover
traits.description: By rapidly beating your feathered wings, you can hold yourself steady in the air for brief periods. When falling, you can use your reaction to halt your descent and hover in place. On subsequent turns you must use a bonus action to continue hovering. When you stop hovering, you glide straight down at 30 feet per round, taking no falling damage and not landing prone. You can't hover while wearing heavy armor or while encumbered.

traits.name: Wing Flap
traits.description: As a bonus action, you can use your feathered arms to propel yourself upward a distance equal to half your movement speed. You can use it together with a regular jump, and can use your Hover trait following your wing flap.

traits.name: Quick Reflexes
traits.description: You can take two reactions in a round. Once you use this ability, you can't use it again until you finish a short or long rest.

traits.name: Moving Target
traits.description: When you take the Dash action, the next attack made against you before the start of your next turn is made with disadvantage.

traits.name: Size
traits.description: Most sylphs are under two and a half feet tall. Your size is Small.

races.name: Tilia
races.description: Gecko-like folk known for their curiosity, openness, and joviality, prizing creativity, wit, and charm. (Humblewood 2 Playtest.)

traits.name: Sticky Grip
traits.description: Your hands and feet have special pads that let you climb in extraordinary ways. You can climb upside down or on difficult surfaces without making ability checks.

traits.name: Sticky Tongue
traits.description: As a bonus action, you can extend your tongue toward an object weighing 20 pounds or less within 20 feet and pull it to you in a straight line. You can catch the object with a free hand; otherwise it lands at your feet. If the object is held or carried, you can maintain your hold by succeeding on an opposed Strength (Athletics) check. Alternatively, you can use your action to project your tongue at a surface within 20 feet, pulling yourself to it and provoking opportunity attacks as normal.

traits.name: Purifying Skin
traits.description: Your scales secrete an oil that protects you from infection. You have advantage on saving throws made to resist being infected with a disease.

traits.name: Size
traits.description: Your size is Medium or Small (your choice).

subraces.name: Treescale Tilia
subraces.description: Adept at blending into forest surroundings, with bright-colored or patterned scales and the ability to secrete a natural toxin.

traits.name: Forest Cunning
traits.description: You have advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made to hide in forests and jungles.

traits.name: Poison Skin
traits.description: Your scales can secrete toxins at will. When a creature touches you or hits you with a melee weapon attack using natural weapons, you can use your reaction to force it to make a Constitution saving throw (DC 8 + your Constitution modifier + your proficiency bonus). On a failure it takes poison damage equal to double your proficiency bonus and is poisoned until the end of your next turn; on a success it takes half as much and isn't poisoned. You can use this a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, regaining all uses on a long rest.

subraces.name: Sandscale Tilia
subraces.description: Perfectly adapted to desert heat, easily hiding and traveling in sandy environments.

traits.name: Desert Lore
traits.description: You have proficiency in the Nature skill. Additionally, you have advantage on Wisdom (Survival) checks made in desert environments.

traits.name: Heat Tolerance
traits.description: You automatically succeed on saving throws to resist exhaustion from exposure to heat in excess of 100 degrees Fahrenheit, and you can survive without water for 4 days before suffering from exhaustion.

traits.name: Sand Swimmer
traits.description: When moving through sand, you have a burrow speed equal to your walking speed, and you have advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks to hide while burrowing through sand.

races.name: Eluran
races.languages: Eluran, plus one language of your choice
races.description: Feline folk renowned for their poise, calm demeanor, and keen insight, blessed with natural magic from the Amaranthines Khaluz and Eresutha. (Humblewood 2 Playtest.)

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.description: You can see in dim light within 60 feet of you as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light (you discern only shades of gray in darkness).

traits.name: Claws
traits.description: You have sharp claws you can use as natural weapons for unarmed strikes. When you hit with them, the strike deals 1d6 + your Strength modifier slashing damage instead of the bludgeoning damage normal for an unarmed strike. Additionally, you have advantage on Strength (Athletics) checks made to climb any surface your claws could reasonably grip.

traits.name: Graceful Landing
traits.description: When you fall, you don't land prone as long as you aren't incapacitated, and you can subtract up to 20 feet from a fall when calculating falling damage.

traits.name: Wariness
traits.description: You have keen senses and a knack for avoiding danger. You have proficiency in the Insight and Perception skills.

traits.name: Size
traits.description: Your size is Medium or Small (your choice).

subraces.name: Moon Eluran
subraces.description: Producing a gentle healing purr; generally smaller than their sun counterparts.

traits.name: Soothing Purr
traits.description: You can produce a comforting purr during a short rest. If you or any friendly creatures who can hear your purr regain hit points at the end of the short rest by spending one or more Hit Dice, each of those creatures regains an extra 2d4 hit points. A creature can't regain extra hit points from this trait again until it finishes a long rest.

traits.name: Paws of the Artist
traits.description: You gain proficiency with a set of artisan's tools or a musical instrument of your choice.

subraces.name: Sun Eluran
subraces.description: Possessing a hunter's instincts and a fearsome roar; more physically imposing than moon elurans.

traits.name: Thunderous Roar
traits.description: As an action, you can unleash a mighty, earth-shaking roar. Each Large or smaller creature within 10 feet of you must succeed on a Constitution saving throw (DC 8 + your Strength modifier + your proficiency bonus) or be knocked prone. Once you use your roar, you can't do so again until you finish a long rest.

traits.name: Hunter's Weapon Training
traits.description: You have proficiency with blowguns, clubs, javelins, longbows, scimitars, and spears.

abilityChoice.hint: typical: moon DEX & WIS, sun STR & WIS

races.name: Seeta
races.languages: Birdfolk, plus two languages of your choice; you also understand Auran but can't speak it
races.description: Diverse, colorful birdfolk with prominent beaks — lifelong learners with a gift for mimicry and unconventional tool use. (Humblewood 2 Playtest.)

traits.name: Glide
traits.description: Using your feathered arms, you can slow your fall and glide short distances. When falling, you can use your reaction to spread your arms and glide, falling 60 feet per round and taking no fall damage when you land. If you fall at least 10 feet this way, you may fly up to your movement speed in a direction of your choice (you can't move upward), landing where you finish your movement. You can't glide while carrying heavy weapons or wielding a shield (though you may drop held items as part of your reaction), while wearing heavy armor, or while encumbered.

traits.name: Wing Flap
traits.description: As a bonus action, you can use your feathered arms to propel yourself upward a distance equal to half your movement speed. You can use it together with a regular jump, but not while gliding.

traits.name: Strong Beak
traits.description: Your large curved beak is a natural weapon you can use for unarmed strikes. On a hit you deal 1d6 + your Strength modifier piercing damage instead of the bludgeoning damage normal for an unarmed strike.

traits.name: Striking Plumage
traits.description: You have proficiency in the Intimidation skill.

traits.name: The Knack
traits.description: You have proficiency with two sets of artisan's tools of your choice. You can also use these tools in unconventional ways: you can use artisan's tools you are proficient with to attempt a check that would usually require a different set of tools, adding half your proficiency bonus (rounded down) to the check.

traits.name: Mimicry
traits.description: You can innately alter your voice to convincingly replicate any sound you've heard, such as another voice, a spell being cast, or the sound of a weapon striking stone. A creature that hears the sounds can tell they are imitations with a successful Wisdom (Insight) check (DC 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Intelligence modifier, minimum of 1).

traits.name: Size
traits.description: Your size is Medium or Small (your choice).

races.name: Capran
races.description: Goat- and sheep-like folk with a steadfast, independent spirit, capable of enduring the most rugged environments. (Humblewood 2 Playtest.)

traits.name: Hard Headed
traits.description: Whether or not you have horns, you can use your tough head to deliver unarmed strikes. On a hit, the strike deals 1d6 + your Strength modifier bludgeoning damage instead of the bludgeoning damage normal for an unarmed strike. If you move at least 20 feet straight toward a target and then hit it with a head unarmed strike, the target must succeed on a Strength saving throw (DC 8 + your Strength modifier + your proficiency bonus) or be knocked prone.

traits.name: Stubborn Mind
traits.description: You have advantage on saving throws against being charmed.

traits.name: Size
traits.description: Caprans generally stand between 5½ and 6½ feet tall and have solid builds. Your size is Medium.

subraces.name: Yantan Capran
subraces.description: Sturdy survivors resembling mountain goats, markhor, and ibexes, adapted to move through harsh, rugged conditions with ease.

traits.name: Legacy of Learning
traits.description: You gain proficiency in one of the following skills of your choice: Animal Handling, Athletics, or History.

traits.name: Sure Footing
traits.description: You ignore nonmagical difficult terrain and have advantage on Dexterity and Strength checks and saving throws made to climb or maintain your balance.

subraces.name: Tethera Capran
subraces.description: Highly social folk resembling bighorn sheep, argali, and mouflon, who value the peace that comes with consensus.

traits.name: Friendly Face
traits.description: You gain proficiency in one of the following skills of your choice: Insight or Persuasion, and you have advantage on checks made to convince humanoids who aren't currently fighting you that you are trustworthy.

traits.name: Flock Together
traits.description: When you take the Help action and the check or attack you are helping with fails, you can allow the creature making the check to reroll it if you are within 5 feet (the creature must use the new result). You can use this a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, regaining all uses on a long rest.
